title: Introduction
body_text:
Thank you for participating to this experiment.

You will have to perform a series of tasks which will consist in identyfing patterns in images. Your goal is to maximize your performance, by trying to provide the right answer for every image. Your bonus financial reward will depend on your overall performance.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.
button_text: I read and understood the instructions

title: Let's jump in
body_text:
Before giving you further instructions, you will perform a first training task in order to discover the interface. This task will NOT count towards your score and remuneration, and the results will not be recorded. You will be presented with a series of 5 images of symbols of colors, and you will have to answer a question regarding the image. For this task and for the rest of the introduction, you will be informed if the decision was right or wrong after each decision.

As for every task later, the question will be the same for every image of the task. The question will usually change every new task, but it will stay the same during the introduction.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.

title: Protocol structure
body_text:
The protocol will last about 30 minutes and is organized as follows.


To conclude the introduction, you will perform a training phase, which consists of two tasks of 5 images.

Then, the main experiment will start. It will be divided into 2 main sessions. Each session consists in solving 4 tasks that will count towards your score and bonus remuneration, and starts with two training tasks, that will help you prepare for the rest of the session. You will also have to answer several surveys during the experiment.

Finally, you will have to answer a final survey to terminate the protocol.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.
button_text: I read and understood the instructions

title: AI assistant
body_text:
To assist you in performing the tasks, you will receive the help of an AI assistant. The AI has access to the same source image as you do, and will provide a suggestion on the decision to be made. However, the AI might make mistakes, and the ultimate decision is your responsability.

In addition, you will have access to a justification of the AI's prediction. It will highlight areas of the image which were important for the prediction. Green areas highlight zones which are leaning towards the decision YES, and red areas highlight zones which are leaning towards the decision NO.

Below is an example of AI prediction and justification for the question "In the image, is there a triangle in every row (1, ..., 6)?"

body_text:
You will now enter the training phase. You will have to perform two tasks, which will allow you to experiment with the AI.

On the first task, you can take as much time as you wish to answer the questions. On the second task, your time will be limited.

As these tasks are for training, your answers will not be recorded and your score will not count towards your bonus remuneration.
